label: Laptop
depicts: Laptop screen frame above one curved lower base line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a laptop with a curved lower base under the open screen frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straight base laptop when the platform should stay flat and level.

label: Checklist View
depicts: Three left check marks aligned beside three horizontal list bars
use_when: Use when the interface wants a checklist with check marks aligned to the left of text bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the square list checks when each row should begin with a square box.

label: Checklist View
depicts: Two square check boxes aligned left beside four horizontal list bars
use_when: Use when the interface wants a checklist using square boxes beside horizontal list bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the three check mark list when the left side should show check marks instead of boxes.

label: Magic
depicts: Star outline with one diagonal wand line crossing the lower right edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants a magic star outline crossed by one wand line.
avoid_when: Do not use for the spark wand when the main star shape should break into short sparkle rays.

label: Magic
depicts: Sparkle burst with short rays above one diagonal wand line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a wand line with a burst of short sparkle rays at the top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the star wand when the sparkle should remain a burst rather than a full star outline.
